description: This is a Java test class for the BaseStorageService component of the OpenMRS project. It contains unit tests for storage service functionalities such as saving, retrieving, and deleting data, as well as listing file keys with various filters.

classes.name: BaseStorageServiceTest
classes.description: An abstract base class for testing storage services in the OpenMRS API. It provides common setup, utility methods, and test cases for persistence and retrieval of data chunks, key listing, and data purging.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Initializes test data and dependencies before each test case.

methods.name: newStorageService
methods.description: Abstract factory method to provide an instance of StorageService for subclasses.

methods.name: getData_shouldThrowExceptionWhenFileDoesNotExist
methods.description: Tests that attempting to retrieve non-existent data throws an IOException.

methods.name: getData_shouldReturnDataWhenFileExists
methods.description: Verifies that retrieving existing data returns the expected content.

methods.name: saveTestData
methods.description: Helper method to save test data with optional module ID and key suffix, then execute verification.

methods.name: saveTestData
methods.description: Overloaded helper method allowing to specify InputStream for test data.

methods.name: saveTempData_shouldPersistData
methods.description: Tests saving temporary data and subsequent retrieval.

methods.name: saveData_shouldPersistDataIfNoModuleIdAndKeySuffix
methods.description: Verifies that data is saved correctly when no module ID or key suffix are specified.

methods.name: saveData_shouldPersistDataWithModuleId
methods.description: Tests saving data with a specified module ID.

methods.name: saveData_shouldPersistDataWithModuleIdAndKeySuffix
methods.description: Tests saving data with both module ID and key suffix.

methods.name: saveData_shouldFailIfModuleIdAndKeySuffixExists
methods.description: Ensures that saving data with duplicate module ID and key suffix raises a FileAlreadyExistsException.

methods.name: saveData_shouldPersistDataIfModuleIdDiffersButKeySuffixSame
methods.description: Verifies that saving data with the same key suffix but different module ID does not conflict.

methods.name: getKeys_shouldListFilesWithGivenModuleIdAndKeySuffix
methods.description: Tests that the service lists correct keys matching provided module ID and key suffix.

methods.name: getKeys_shouldListFilesWithGivenModuleIdAndKeySuffixWithoutDirs
methods.description: Tests listing keys without directories included.

methods.name: getKeys_shouldListFilesWithoutGivenModuleIdAndWithKeySuffix
methods.description: Verifies listing keys when no module ID is provided.

methods.name: getKeys_shouldListFilesOnlyForGivenModule
methods.description: Tests filtering keys to only those belonging to a specific module.

methods.name: getKeys_shouldListFilesOnlyForGlobal
methods.description: Tests listing keys only at the global scope (no module).

methods.name: getKeys_shouldListFilesAndDirsOnlyForCurrentDir
methods.description: Verifies that listing with a directory prefix includes files and immediate directories.

methods.name: getKeys_shouldListAllFilesAndDirsFromDir
methods.description: Tests recursive listing of files and directories from a subdirectory.

methods.name: getKeys_shouldListAllFilesAndDirsFromRoot
methods.description: Tests listing all files and directories from the root of the storage.

methods.name: getKeys_shouldListAllFilesAndDirsFromParentDirOnly
methods.description: Verifies listing files and directories in parent directory context.

methods.name: purgeData_shouldReturnTrueWhenDeleted
methods.description: Tests that purging existing data returns true and data is deleted.

methods.name: purgeData_shouldReturnFalseIfNotExists
methods.description: Verifies that attempting to purge non-existent data returns false.

methods.name: exists_shouldReturnTrueWhenFileExists
methods.description: Checks that the existence check returns true for existing data.

methods.name: exists_shouldReturnFalseWhenFileMissing
methods.description: Checks that the existence check returns false for missing data.

methods.name: saveData_shouldHandleWindowsPathSeparatorInKey
methods.description: Ensures that saving data with Windows-style path separators in keys works correctly.

methods.name: saveData_shouldNotFailIfModuleIdOrGroupContainsAllowedCharacters
methods.description: Tests that saving data with permitted special characters in module ID does not fail.

methods.name: saveData_shouldFailIfModuleIdOrGroupContainsBadCharacters
methods.description: Ensures that invalid characters in module ID or group cause save to fail with IllegalArgumentException.

methods.name: saveData_shouldNotCreateFileIfErrorOccursWhenCopyingData
methods.description: Checks that if an error occurs during data copy, no file is created.
